problem: Composed explicit reason yields отклоняются, пока … не осталось репозиториев; unavailable reason yields пока не удалось получить … . The completed-past clauses are not an idiomatic ongoing refusal condition, and the explicit reading can suggest until none remain. Introduce the reason as a reason; existing English/fragment keys do not need changes.
